item.description: Sani, Zulum, Yusuf, Abiodun, Uzodimma, others in attendance as Tinubu convenes governors, cabinet members for Ramadan Iftar at Presidential Villa.

item.description: Gencos cite regulatory risks, unpaid N6.2tn debt and weak PPAs for Nigeria’s persistent 4,000MW power generation.

item.description: Tinubu says Nigeria has exited crisis, promises state police, urges unity as governors praise inclusive leadership.

item.title: ARISE News Honours 100 Leading African Women At 2026 Africa Women Of Impact Awards
item.description: ARISE News Channel celebrates 100 influential African women, spotlighting leadership across governance, business, healthcare, technology and creative industries.
